title: Five improved lower bounds for Zarankiewicz numbers z(m,n;3,3)
summary: We record five improved lower bounds for Zarankiewicz numbers with s = t = 3: z(13,19;3,3) >= 118, z(14,19;3,3) >= 126, z(16,18;3,3) >= 136, z(14,20;3,3) >= 126, z(16,19;3,3) >= 136. The first three are certified by explicit K_{3,3}-free 0/1 matrices; the last two follow from the second and third by monotone padding. Compared with the lower bounds compiled in Figure 2 of arXiv:2605.01120, namely 114, 121, 130, 125 and 132, the improvements are +4, +5, +6, +1 and +4 respectively.
